text_block_list.text:
When I came to the library
to look for race-related materials—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fuwaah... That was such a wonderful story.
Rice wants to make a story like this into a picture book too...

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san.
So this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bourbon-san.
Did you need Rice for something?

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. A critical issue has arisen
that exploits my vulnerabilities.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I have been assigned to speak about running
in front of children during the orientation, but...

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am unfamiliar with the protocol and cannot formulate
a simulation for successful mission execution.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I thought you might possess some useful tips,
so I came to consult you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ummm... Rice wonders if she can really be of any help...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Then, could you let me hear what you have so far?
Just pretend Rice is one of the little kids.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. A trial operation.
Commencing test.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Therefore, acceleration is determined by step-in force
and muscular strength.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Conclusion of presentation. What is your evaluation?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um, I'm sorry, but
it might sound just a little bit too stiff...

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Stiff, you say.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...How is this?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Umm... your smile is super cute, but
it's not your expression, it's just that the talk itself is a bit difficult...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
For little kids, it'd probably be better
to make it more fun and easier to understand...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bourbon-san.
How about a "picture-story show"?

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A picture-story show... Kamishibai?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That way, everyone can have fun
listening to the story.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...However, I lack experience in creating picture-story shows,
and time for production is exceedingly limited.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It'll be okay, Rice is sure of it.
Rice will help you out too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-san, you're being so serious about this
because you want everyone to enjoy running, right?

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To be precise, it is because I received orders, but...
certainly, that sentiment does exist within me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Then let's do our best together!
Rice wants the little kids
to have fun running, too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure we'll make a wonderful picture-story show!
Having a goal gives you strength!

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Gives strength... Understood. Let us proceed.
For the sake of the children.
